newsitem.title: PERU: Child dies, 15 injured in crash in southern Peru.
newsitem.headline: Child dies, 15 injured in crash in southern Peru.

text.p: A four-year-old child died and 15 other people were injured when a truck slammed into a van picking up passengers on the side of a highway in southern Peru, police said on Sunday.

A police spokesman told Reuters the truck's driver was blinded by the lights of an on-coming car, swerved and struck a van stopped on the side of the Pan American Highway near Moquegua, some 733 miles (1,180 kms) south of Lima.
"All the victims were from the combi (van). The girl must have been in the front," he said.
The crash occurred at 7:45 p.m. Saturday (0045 GMT Sunday).
